title: free5GC PCF through 1.4.6 contains a resource leak in postAppSessCtxProcedure that leaves PCC rules and QoS data in…
description: free5GC PCF versions through 1.4.6 have a resource leak vulnerability in the postAppSessCtxProcedure function. This flaw causes PCC rules and QoS data to remain in the SM policy decision after rejected Npcf_PolicyAuthorization create requests. Authenticated application functions (AFs) with knowledge of an active PDU session's UE address can exploit this by sending repeated failing requests with distinct AF application identifiers, leading to increased memory usage and pollution of policy data sent to the SMF.
